metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities, dye spectra from Fujifilm AF3-149E, FUJICHROME ASTIA 100F Professional [RAP100F], E-6/CR-56, Status A. The curves were read from the vector plot, each layer by its dash pattern, and converted from Status A densities into dye amounts with the sheet's dye spectra and the base density of the agx reference profile 'fujifilm_provia_100f'. Exposure axis aligned to 'fujifilm_provia_100f' at the D-min + 1.0 speed point (offset +0.872 decades). Layer speeds set so a grey views neutral from three stops under mid-grey to two over: red -0.056, blue +0.030 decades against green; the curves are otherwise as drawn. The sheet's sensitivity shapes continue on the donor's tails beyond the plotted range and are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. Base density, Hanatos-2025 adaptation parameters, DIR couplers inherited from 'fujifilm_provia_100f', which shares this stock's dye set and process.
